stage_objective: Confirm the committed terminal sentinel after PROJECT-COMPLETE without adding features: verify the PROJECT-COMPLETE closure and committed main post-state, confirm Final Overall Acceptance and Project Complete remain CLOSED_LOCAL_VERIFIED, confirm the repository remains clean/public-safe, classify any external MCP/browser drift as harness evidence unless repository contradiction appears, and stop the recursive chain once the terminal condition is verified.
required_outputs: read PROJECT-COMPLETE-CLOSURE and verify its committed SOURCE_HEAD/post-state rather than reopening implementation
confirm Final Overall Acceptance and Project Complete are CLOSED_LOCAL_VERIFIED and main remains clean/public-safe
verify the machine-local PROJECT-COMPLETE -> TERMINAL handoff receipt/hash when available without copying private browser or endpoint state into Git
make no implementation, architecture, packaging, release or lifecycle changes unless contradictory repository-owned evidence appears
record only minimum terminal confirmation bookkeeping if evidence requires it
after terminal verification, stop the recursive chain because TERMINAL is the sentinel and there is no further implementation stage
do_not_redo: Stages 0-12, Final Overall Acceptance or Project Complete implementation/tests without contradictory repository-owned evidence
new features, redesigns, repackaging, publication/push or speculative cleanup
machine-local credentials, endpoints, browser profiles, cookies, tokens, PIDs, conversation URLs or unrelated repositories
creating another implementation stage after the terminal condition is satisfied
known_risks: A terminal sentinel can accidentally loop into itself if generic recursive handoff wording is applied mechanically; the termination condition outranks self-reentry once Final Overall Acceptance and Project Complete are both closed.
External MCP/session/browser selector health may drift independently of the accepted repository.
Remote origin/main may lag the canonical local main; publication remains a separate user-owned external side effect unless explicitly authorized.
